name: MiniMax H3
note: [MiniMax H3](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3) supports text-to-video and first/last-frame-conditioned generation. Use the canvas image for the first frame and the first enabled moodboard image for the last frame, or omit images for text-to-video. The CFG-distilled base model generates 24 FPS video with synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio. Start with a 768-pixel short side, 50 DDIM Trailing steps, Text Guidance 1, Shift 12, and Audio Shift 3.
